_readme: THE ONE FILE TO EDIT for the computer app (Windows, Mac, Linux). See DESKTOP_APP_GUIDE.md.
_version_readme: Raise 'version' (e.g. 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1) every time you publish a new computer app. Installed apps update themselves to it. Website changes do NOT need a new version.
_devUrl_readme: TESTING ONLY. Put your local Django address here (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000) to test against `runserver`. Leave it EMPTY ("") before publishing. The GitHub build refuses to run while it is set.
_hosts_readme: Web addresses that open INSIDE the app. Every other address opens in the computer's normal web browser.
_payment_hosts_readme: Payment pages that open inside the app (Paystack), so paying works the same as on the website.
_window_readme: The window's size the first time it opens. After that it remembers where the user left it.
_capture_readme: true = screenshots, screen recording and screen sharing show the app as black (Windows and Mac; Linux can't). false = allow them, e.g. for a teacher sharing the screen in class.
_updates_readme: How often a running app checks for a new version of itself, in hours.
_download_page_readme: Opened when an update can't install itself (Mac without an Apple certificate, Linux .deb). Path on siteUrl.
